lines: When someone forgets your birthday, they usually mean “You’re not on their priority list.”
You smile, pretend it’s okay, but the sting remains.
The next week they remember your favorite coffee.
It feels like a band-aid, not genuine care.
Notice how often you’re the last to be remembered.
Your value isn’t tied to a date on a calendar.
Set a standard: you deserve consistent attention.
Walk away from anyone who treats you like an afterthought.
Follow for more daily psychology that can change your life.

caption: Don’t settle for occasional reminders. Share if you’ve ever felt like an afterthought.
